_instructions: Upload this file as 'manifest.json' into each conference folder in your private S3 bucket.
The 'file' field is the XLSX filename that sits in the same S3 folder.
Lambda reads this manifest, generates presigned URLs for each file, and returns
them to the browser with 'path' set to the signed URL.
platinum entries must have: file, country, sectors[].silverSector, sectors[].platSector
rlca entries must have:     file, country, year, sectors[].silverSector, sectors[].rlcaSector
Delete the '_instructions' key before uploading (or leave it — Lambda ignores unknown keys).

sectors.silverSector: Printed Circuit Board and populated board
sectors.platSector: Printed Circuit Board and populated board

sectors.silverSector: Manufacture of sweets, chewing gum and confectionery products other than chocolate
sectors.platSector: Manufacturing of sugar, chocolate, candy, etc

sectors.silverSector: Manufacture of sweets, chewing gum and confectionery products other than chocolate
sectors.rlcaSector: Manufacture of sweets, chewing gum and confectionery products other than chocolate
